ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If the population of raccoons decreases, what will most likely happen to the population of fish?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, and the arrows indicate from food or prey toward the animal that eats it. In the figure, there is an arrow from Fish to Raccoons, showing that raccoons eat fish. Reasoning: If the number of raccoons decreases, the pressure of raccoon predation on fish will become smaller, so more fish will survive. Therefore the fish population is most likely to increase.
